data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reports no material change in gross prior-year reserves on a gross basis at 31 December 2022 (gross claims outstanding opening balance $1,806.7m). The Managing Agent reports a net release of $57.8m (net of reinsurance) attributable across several classes, but the gross claims development triangle shows negligible aggregate movement on prior underwriting years (i.e. effectively flat gross prior-year development). The net release reported is therefore after reinsurer shares and the gross position is effectively unchanged.
raw_causal_phrases: There has been a reassessment of the net provision for claims outstanding held at the previous year end. The release in 2022 amounted to $57.8m (2021: $57.0m), attributable to the following classes of business:

Specific reserving uncertainties as at 31 December 2022 include the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic. Net technical provisions include $34.4m (2021: $49.0m) relating to COVID-19 arising primarily in the Contingency class of business which was discontinued in 2021.
data.data_quality_notes: The note titled 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' (page 33) reports a net release of $57.8m (NET of reinsurance). That movement note shows NET amounts only. Per instructions, the gross prior year movement was obtained by fallback to the gross claims development triangle (page 40). The triangle indicates negligible aggregate gross prior-year movement (effectively flat); due to image extraction and alignment of columns/rows there is moderate uncertainty in interpreting individual UW-year development, so the gross prior-year development is reported as 0.0 with confidence 0.8. Lob-level movements reported in the movement note are NET amounts; these were mapped to standard LOBs where possible and signed (releases negative).

_claims_triangle.notes: A gross claims development triangle is present on page 40. Exact row-by-row numeric extraction from the scanned image is uncertain; the triangle was used qualitatively to determine that aggregate gross prior-year development was effectively flat. Development rows omitted here due to image extraction uncertainty.
